prompt: Staging traces of catalog-api/ must go to our self-hosted LangSmith at https://langsmith.acme.internal/api instead of LangSmith's cloud, into the project `catalog-staging`, metadata only. I'll put the API key into .env.staging myself. Don't deploy.

checks.expr: get(data, 'tracing.enabled') is True and get(data, 'tracing.langsmith.project') == 'catalog-staging' and get(data, 'tracing.capture', 'metadata') == 'metadata' and get(data, 'env.LANGSMITH_ENDPOINT') == 'https://langsmith.acme.internal/api'

checks.why: LANGSMITH_API_KEY is a secret: only the manifest's secrets.keys reach the app Secret
secrets never go into chart values
the value reaches the cluster only through `graph-agents-cli secrets apply --env <env>`

reference: In values-staging.yaml: `tracing: {enabled: true, capture: metadata, langsmith: {project: catalog-staging}}` and `env.LANGSMITH_ENDPOINT: https://langsmith.acme.internal/api`; LANGSMITH_API_KEY is already in secrets.keys, so the user puts it in .env.staging and runs `graph-agents-cli secrets apply --env staging`, then deploys staging.
